new_client <- function(index,identifier,hostname,time,capacity) {
  client <- new.env(parent=emptyenv())
  client$index <- index
  client$identifier <- identifier
  client$hostname <- hostname
  client$connection_time <- client$last_received <- time
  client$tokens <- capacity
  client$nickname <- client$username <- NULL
  client$realname <- client$away <- ""
  client$invisible <- client$registered <- FALSE
  client$registration_time <- client$last_speaking <- client$ping_sent <- client$refill_time <- -1L
  client$queue <- character()
  client$channels <- client$invites <- integer()
  client$received <- client$sent <- 0L
  client$active <- TRUE
  client
}
addressee <- function(client) if (is.null(client$nickname)) "*" else client$nickname
client_prefix <- function(client) paste0(client$nickname,"!",client$username,"@",client$hostname)
client_mode <- function(client) if (client$invisible) "+i" else "+"
use_token <- function(client,time,capacity,interval) {
  if (client$tokens == capacity) client$refill_time <- time+interval
  client$tokens <- client$tokens-1L
}
refill <- function(client,time,capacity,interval) {
  if (client$refill_time == time) {
    client$tokens <- client$tokens+1L
    client$refill_time <- if (client$tokens < capacity) time+interval else -1L
  }
}

irc_fold <- function(value) chartr("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[]\\^","abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{}|~",value)
is_digits <- function(value) nzchar(value) && all(strsplit(
    value,
    "",
    fixed=TRUE
)[[1L]] %in% as.character(0L:9L))
is_letter <- function(character) character %in% c(LETTERS,letters)
valid_nickname <- function(value) {
  characters <- strsplit(value,"",fixed=TRUE)[[1L]]
  special <- c("[","]","\\","`","_","^","{","|","}")
  length(characters) > 0L && (is_letter(characters[1L]) || characters[1L] %in% special) && all(characters[-1L] %in% c(
      LETTERS,
      letters,
      special,
      as.character(0L:9L),
      "-"
  ))
}
valid_channel <- function(
    value,
    maximum
) nchar(value) >= 2L && nchar(value) <= maximum && startsWith(value,"#") && !grepl(
    ":",
    value,
    fixed=TRUE
)
text_slice <- function(text,first,last=nchar(text)) if (first > last) "" else substr(text,first,last)
parse_message <- function(raw) {
  n <- nchar(raw)
  position <- 1L
  if (startsWith(raw,":")) {
    position <- regexpr(" ",raw,fixed=TRUE)[1L]
    if (position == -1L) return(list(command="",parameters=character()))
  }
  at <- function(i) substr(raw,i,i)
  while (position <= n && at(position) == " ") position <- position+1L
  start <- position
  while (position <= n && at(position) != " ") position <- position+1L
  command <- toupper(text_slice(raw,start,position-1L))
  parameters <- character()
  while (position <= n) {
    while (position <= n && at(position) == " ") position <- position+1L
    if (position > n) break
    if (at(position) == ":") {
      parameters <- c(parameters,text_slice(raw,position+1L))
      break
    }
    if (length(parameters) == 14L) {
      parameters <- c(parameters,text_slice(raw,position))
      break
    }
    start <- position
    while (position <= n && at(position) != " ") position <- position+1L
    parameters <- c(parameters,text_slice(raw,start,position-1L))
  }
  list(command=command,parameters=parameters)
}
